book.name: Ruuka
book.title: Amangʼana Amazʉmu ga Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ chɨmbu gaandikirwɨ na Ruuka

content: Yɨɨsu arahirwa kwa Piraato
Akʉmara, abhakʉrʉ bhʉʉsi bha Abhayaahudi bhakiimɨɨrɨra, bhakahira Yɨɨsu kwa Piraato.

Bhakatanga kʉmʉgamba kwa bhʉhaari, bharabhuga, “Tʉrʉʉzɨ ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ, ararimirya icharʉ chɨtʉ, kwa kʉbharecha abhaatʉ bhatarɨha rigʉʉti kwa Kaisaari. Akʉmara arabhuga kʉbha ewe newe Kiriisitʉ, ʉmʉtɨmi.”
Neho Piraato akabhuurya Yɨɨsu, “Awɨ naawɨ ʉmʉtɨmi wa Abhayaahudi?” Akabhuga, “Awɨ ʉgambirɨ.”
Piraato akabhʉʉrɨra abhakʉrʉ bha abhakuhaani, hamwɨmwɨ na riribhita rya abhaatʉ, “Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ, rɨtareeho isoro ryʉryʉsi rɨnʉ nɨrʉʉzɨ kwawe.”
Abhaatʉ bhayo, bhakakandikija kʉgamba, “Ndora amaragɨrɨra gaazɨ, garareeta rirɨgɨ kʉbhaatʉ bha mucharʉ chʉsi cha Yudeya! Akatangɨra Gariraaya, na amarirɨ kʉganyaraganʼya kuhika hanʉ.”
Piraato akagiigwa gayo, akabhuurya, “Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ nɨ‑Mʉgariraaya?”
Hanʉ aamɨnyirɨ ewe nɨ‑Mʉgariraaya wʉ ʉbhʉtɨmi bhwa Heroode, akamʉtʉma kwawe kʉ kʉbha, zisikʉ ziyo Heroode wʉʉsi aarɨ Yɨrusarɨɨmu.
Heroode arabhuurya Yɨɨsu
Hanʉ Heroode aarʉʉzɨ Yɨɨsu, akazomerwa bhʉkʉngʼu, kʉ kʉbha akiigwa amangʼana gaazɨ kwa sikʉ nzaru. Akabha areenda korora ɨkɨsɨgʉ kɨnʉ Yɨɨsu akokora.
Heroode akabhuurya amangʼana maaru, nawe Yɨɨsu atamʉgarukiiryɨ ingʼana.
Abhakʉrʉ bha abhakuhaani na abhiija bhi imigirʉ, bhakahɨta embere kʉgamba Yɨɨsu kwa bhʉhaari.
Heroode wʉʉsi na abhasirikarɨ bhaazɨ bhakatanga komorega, bhakamoseka, bhakamwibhohya zengebho zɨnzʉmu. Akʉmara bhakamʉgarucha kwa Piraato.
Kwɨma urusikʉ ruyo, Heroode na Piraato bhakabha bhasaani, nʉʉrʉ bhaarɨ bhatakwigwana.
Piraato aratɨnɨra Yɨɨsu
Akʉmara, Piraato akabhiringa abhakʉrʉ bha abhakuhaani, abhiimiiririri bha Abhayaahudi, hamwɨmwɨ na abhaatʉ.

Akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Heene! Mʉndɨɨtɨɨrɨ ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ, mʉrabhuga arasiigirirya abhaatʉ. Momenye bhwaheene nɨmarirɨ kumubhuurya mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwanyu. Kʉmagamba gaanyu gʉʉsi, rɨtareeho ingʼana ryʉryʉsi rɨnʉ nɨrʉʉzɨ kwawe.
Heroode wʉʉsi, atarʉʉzɨ isoro kwawe. Necho amʉgarukiryɨ kwa niitwɨ. Momenye bhwaheene kʉbha ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ, rɨtareeho isoro rɨnʉ akʉrirɨ, rɨnʉ rekokora iitwɨ!
Nangʉ nɨramotema zihimbʉ, akʉmara nimutigʉrʉkɨrɨ.” [
Ribhaga ryɨ Ɨpasaka, Piraato akeenderwa atigʉrʉkɨrɨ omobhohwa wʉmwɨ.]
Abhaatʉ bhayo bhʉʉsi, bhakarɨgɨsa kwa hamwɨmwɨ bharabhuga, “Zɨyi! Muruushɨho wʉnʉ, ʉtʉtazʉrɨrɨ Bharaabha!”
Na Bharaabha akabhohwa mokebhoho kʉ kʉbha akareeta rirɨgɨ ryaru mʉrʉbhɨri na kwita.
Piraato akeenda kutigʉrʉka Yɨɨsu, naatu akagambana nabhʉ.
Nawe, bhakangʼeha kʉrɨgɨsa, “Mʉmʉbhambɨ kʉmʉsarabha, mʉmʉbhambɨ kʉmʉsarabha!”
Akagamba nabhʉ rwa katatʉ, “Asariryɨkɨ? Ndora rɨtareeho isoro rɨnʉ nɨrʉʉzɨ kwawe rikugirya iitwɨ! Nangʉ nɨramotema zihimbʉ, akʉmara nimutigʉrʉkɨrɨ.”
Nawe, abhaatʉ bhayo bhakangʼeha kʉrɨgɨsa bhʉkʉngʼu kʉbha Yɨɨsu abhambwɨ kʉmʉsarabha. Ɨtɨnɨrʉ, rirɨgɨ ryabhʉ rɨkahiza.
Neho Piraato akabhiisiririrya Abhayaahudi bhayo kokora chɨmbu bhakwenda.
Akatazʉra ʉmʉsarya wʉnʉ aarɨ abhʉhirwɨ, igʉrʉ wo okoreeta rirɨgɨ ryaru na kwita. Akabhaha Yɨɨsu, korereke bhamokore chɨmbu bhakwenda.
Yɨɨsu arabhambwa kʉmʉsarabha

Hanʉ abhasirikarɨ bhaarɨ bharahira Yɨɨsu kumwita, bhakarumana nʉ ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉmwɨ, iriina ryazɨ Simʉʉni, wʉ ʉrʉbhɨri rwa Kireene, ararwa mʉmʉgʉndʉ. Bhakamugwata kwa nguru, bhakamoseserya ʉmʉsarabha, akabha ararwa Yɨɨsu inyuma.
Abhaatʉ bhaaru bhakatuna Yɨɨsu, gatɨ waabhʉ, abhakari bhaarɨ bharamʉrɨrɨra kwi isʉngʉ ihaari.
Yɨɨsu akabhiichʉrɨra akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Imwɨ abhakari bha Yɨrusarɨɨmu, mʉtandɨrɨra! Nawe mwirɨrɨrɨ imubheene na abhaana bhaanyu.
Kʉ kʉbha kuzisikʉ zɨnʉ zikuuza abhaatʉ bharabhuga, hakɨrɨku abhakari abhagʉmba, na bhanʉ bhatakʉchiryɨ abhaana.
Akʉmara, neho bharaabhugɨ, ‘Ɨbhɨgʉrʉ mutugwɨrɨ, nɨ ɨhɨgʉrʉ mutubhumbikiryɨ.’
Arɨɨbhɨ ganʉ garakorwa kʉmʉtɨ ʉmʉbhɨsɨ, ɨrabhabhwɨ kʉmʉtɨ umwʉmu?”
Ribhaga riyo, abhasirikarɨ bhakahira Yɨɨsu na abhasarya bhabhɨrɨ kwitwa.
Bhakahika ahagero hanʉ haabhirikiirwɨ Ɨkɨhanga chu Umutwɨ, bhakamʉbhamba kʉmʉsarabha, na abhasarya bhayo, ʉwʉmwɨ ʉrʉbhaara rwazɨ rwu ubhuryʉ, nʉ ʉwʉndɨ ʉrʉbhaara rwʉ ʉbhʉmʉsi.
Yɨɨsu akabhuga, “Bhaabha! Ʉbhabheerere, kʉ kʉbha bhatɨɨzɨ rɨnʉ bhakokora.” Na bhakatwana amiibhoho gaazɨ kwa kokora ubhwitʉʉri.
Abhaatʉ bhakiimɨɨrɨra bhararora, na abhakʉrʉ bha Abhayaahudi, bhakatanga komorega, bharabhuga, “Akabhasabhʉra abhandɨ. Arɨɨbhɨ newe Kiriisitʉ wʉnʉ arʉbhwɨrwɨ na Mungu, isabhʉrɨ umwene!”
Abhasirikarɨ bhʉʉsi bhakamorega kwo okomoha amarwa amarʉrʉ gi idivaayi.
Bhakamʉbhʉʉrɨra, “Arɨɨbhɨ awɨ nɨ‑mʉtɨmi wa Abhayaahudi, isabhʉra aumwene!”
Gakatuurwa igʉrʉ waazɨ amaandɨkʉ garabhuga, “Wʉnʉ newe ʉmʉtɨmi wa Abhayaahudi.”
Gatɨ wa abhasarya bhabhɨrɨ bhayo, ʉwʉmwɨ akatʉka Yɨɨsu arabhuga, “Awɨ ʉtarɨ Kiriisitʉ? Isabhʉra aumwene! Na niitwɨ, ʉtʉsabhʉrɨ!”
Nawe, ʉmʉkɨndichazɨ akamorecha, akabhuga, “Awɨ ʉtakwʉbhaha Mungu nʉʉrʉ hasuuhu? Awɨ nʉ ʉmʉʉtʉ wuyo ɨtɨnɨrʉ yaanyu nɨ‑mwɨmwɨ.
Itwɨ tutiniirwɨ koheene, kʉrɨngʼaana na amahocha gɨɨtʉ, wʉnʉ, rɨtareeho isoro rɨnʉ akʉrirɨ.”
Akʉmara, akabhuga, “Yɨɨsu! Hanʉ ʉraasikɨrɨ mʉbhʉtɨmi bhwazʉ, unhiitɨ!”
Akamʉgarukirya, “Nɨrakʉbhʉʉrɨra amaheene, reero tʉrabha hamwɨmwɨ mwisaarʉ.”
Uruku rwa Yɨɨsu
Ribhaga ryɨ ɨsa isaasabha umwise, kʉkabha ni ikiirimya mucharʉ chʉsi kuhika zɨɨsa kenda umwise,
kʉ kʉbha iryʉbha rɨkarima. Na ripaziya ryu ukusikɨra Aharɨndu ha Aharɨndu mwihekaaru,
rogendo rʉmwɨ rɨkabhaarʉka mbaara ibhɨrɨ!
Yɨɨsu akarɨra kwiraka ikʉrʉ, “Bhaabha! Mʉmabhoko gaazʉ, nɨratʉʉra ekoro yaanɨ.”
Hanʉ aamarirɨ kʉgamba gayo, akatinʼya. Hanʉ ʉmʉkʉrʉ wa abhasirikarɨ aarʉʉzɨ gayo, akakumya Mungu akubhuga, “Amaheene, ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ ataakʉrirɨ isoro ryʉryʉsi mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa Mungu!”
Abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhaarɨ bhiibhiringirɨ korora amangʼana gayo, bhakagarʉka mumijɨ jabhʉ, bhariitema ibhikubha bhyabhʉ kwa kurumɨka.
Bhʉʉsi bhanʉ bhaamɨnyirɨ Yɨɨsu, bhakiikara kore hasuuhu, bhakarora ganʉ gakokorwa. Gatɨ waabhʉ, kwarɨ na abhakari bhanʉ bhaamutunirɨ kwɨma Gariraaya.
Yɨɨsu arabhiikwa
Kwarɨ nʉ ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉmwɨ ʉmʉzʉmu na we eheene, iriina ryazɨ Yuusufu, wʉmwɨ wi ichandarʉ ɨkɨkʉrʉ cha Abhayaahudi,
nawe atiisirirɨɨnʼyɨ nabhʉ igʉrʉ wa amangʼana gaabhʉ. Ʉmʉʉtʉ wuyo aarɨ wi icharʉ cha Arimataaya na aarɨ ararɨnda kwa bhoono kʉrʉ ukuuza kwʉ ʉbhʉtɨmi bhwa Mungu.
Neho Yuusufu akaja kwa Piraato, akamʉsabha ahaabhwɨ ɨkɨtʉndʉ cha Yɨɨsu.

Piraato akiisirirya, Yuusufu akaja, akiicha ɨkɨtʉndʉ kurwa kʉmʉsarabha, akakiringɨra mʉsanda. Akʉmara, akakihindirya mumbiihɨra yɨnʉ ɨkɨrɨɨsirwɨ kwitarɨ, na mumbiihɨra muyo, atareeho mʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ abhiikirwɨmu.
Urusikʉ ruyo, rwarɨ urusikʉ rwa Abhayaahudi kwikonza
kwʉ ʉbhʉtʉʉrʉ. Urusikʉ rwʉ ʉbhʉtʉʉrʉ rwarɨ rʉraariirɨ.
Abhakari bhanʉ bhiizirɨ hamwɨmwɨ na Yɨɨsu kurwa Gariraaya, bhakatuna Yuusufu. Bhakarora imbihɨra yiyo, na chɨmbu ɨkɨtʉndʉ kɨtɨɨrwɨ.
Neho bhakagarʉka munyumba, bhakakora amaguta go okoreetya. Nawe bhakoyeera urusikʉ rwʉ ʉbhʉtʉʉrʉ, chɨmbu yaswajibhwɨ.

footnotes.text: Ripaziya ryu ukusikɨra Aharɨndu ha Aharɨndu mwihekaaru riyo ryarɨ mwihekaaru, rɨrakɨnga abhaatʉ bhatasikɨra Aharɨndu ha Aharɨndu, hanʉ ubhwɨrʉ bhwa Mungu bhwikɨɨrɨ. Rora Abhɨɨbhuraaniya 6:19, 10:19‑22. Kʉmaragɨrɨra bhʉkʉngʼu, rora ringʼana rihekaaru muKiniibhasa.
Urusikʉ rwa Abhayaahudi kwikonza, ni‑Ijumaa, nerwe Abhayaahudi bhahiikonza, korereke bhabhɨ bhwaheene kurusikʉ rwabhʉ rwʉ ʉbhʉtʉʉrʉ.
